data.body: **[P2] Standardize storage failure classification in the public contract.** The requirements allow retries only for transient storage failures, but `PayloadOffloader` provides no common signal by which the SDK can distinguish transient I/O from authorization, path, integrity, or interruption failures. Define a documented exception hierarchy or classifier carrying failure kind and retryability, plus wrapping and interruption-preservation rules, so custom backends cannot be retried or checkpointed incorrectly.
